text:
emma: Quick pulse — post-webinar metric check. Dashboard: https://app.redwood.com/dash/launch-q3. Noting a ~28% spike in inbound leads yesterday but MQL->SQL conversion down ~12% in APAC. Can analytics confirm if attribution/routing quirks explain this? cc @nina

lio: I glanced at routing logs — there’s a sizable chunk tagged as `unknown_campaign` that got routed to the SDR queue. Could be a missing UTM or form ref. :thinking_face:

nina: Starting a quick run now. Topline: total leads = 1,482; webinar-attrib = 1,020; unknown = 462. Conversion drop is concentrated in the unknown group, APAC heavy. Will post sample rows.

dash-bot: snapshot generated for dashboard launch-q3 (run_id=3421) — view at https://app.redwood.com/snap/3421 :chart_with_upwards_trend:

sam: I can re-run the routing job with the UTM-fallback and reassign unknown->campaign if we confirm it's safe. Want me to run a replay for the last 48h?

emma: Yes please run the replay. Also need a sample CSV of the top 50 most recent unknown leads to hand to Sales Ops for manual triage. We'll include the conclusion in Monday's KPI update.

nina: Running the sample query now, will DM CSV to @sam when ready. Query I'm using:```
SELECT id, email, campaign_source, utm_medium, created_at
FROM leads
WHERE campaign_source = 'unknown'
  AND created_at >= now() - interval '48 hours'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

lio: FYI there was a front-end deploy at 2025-08-02T15:12:00Z that changed form ref handling. Might explain missing UTMs for sessions that hit the new flow. Tagging @frontend for follow-up.

sam: Scheduling a 30-min cleanup window at 14:00 PT today to run the replay and apply the fallback. Invite sent to emma/lia/nina. I'll post logs here when done.

nina: CSV ready. DM sent to @sam with sample and a short blurb on conv metrics by cohort. Preliminary note: if we reassign unknown->webinar, the adjusted webinar-attrib conversion rate aligns with our baseline.

emma: Great — once replay finishes, can you paste the pre/post numbers here (total leads, webinar-attrib, MQL->SQL %) so I can drop into the weekly KPI note? :thumbsup:

sam: Will do. Running now — ETA ~18 mins.

nina: Pre: leads=1,482 / webinar=1,020 / unknown=462 / MQL->SQL (APAC unknown)=6.4%. Post (simulated reassignment): leads=1,482 / webinar-adjusted=1,382 / MQL->SQL (APAC webinar)=8.9%. I'll attach the cohort diff to the KPI doc.

emma: Perfect. I'll add a short blurb to the KPI report: "Instrumented form change caused ~462 leads to land in unknown bucket; replay and UTM-fallback restored expected webinar attribution and raised APAC MQL->SQL by ~2.5 pts."

sam: Replay completed, logs: ```INFO reassign 462 leads -> campaign=webinar-q3; duration=11m23s; errors=0``` — export uploaded: https://app.redwood.com/exports/replay-3421.csv

emma: Thanks team. We'll monitor today and follow up in the Monday KPI call if anything else pops up. :eyes:
